problem.title: The Pirate's Cargo Queue
problem.statement: Help Captain Blackbeard process a sequence of cargo loading and unloading operations on his pirate ship using a queue structure and output the final state of the cargo hold.
problem.description: Captain Blackbeard is organizing his pirate ship's cargo hold. The cargo hold operates as a queue where items are added to the back and removed from the front. You are given a sequence of operations representing the crew loading and unloading treasure chests. There are three types of operations: Push X (add a treasure chest with weight X to the back of the queue), Pop (remove the treasure chest at the front of the queue if the queue is not empty, doing nothing if it is already empty), and Weight (calculate and record the total weight of all chests currently in the queue). Your task is to process all operations in order and output the recorded total weights for each Weight operation.
problem.inputFormat: The first line contains an integer N, the number of operations. Each of the next N lines contains an operation: either "PUSH X" where X is an integer representing the weight of the chest, "POP", or "WEIGHT".
problem.outputFormat: For each "WEIGHT" operation, print the total weight of the chests currently in the queue on a new line. If the queue is empty during a WEIGHT operation, print 0.
problem.sampleExplanation: Initially the queue is empty. PUSH 10 adds a chest of weight 10 (queue: [10], total: 10). PUSH 20 adds a chest of weight 20 (queue: [10, 20], total: 30). WEIGHT outputs 30. POP removes the front chest (10), leaving queue: [20], total: 20. WEIGHT outputs 20.

bruteForce.approach: Simulate the queue directly using a Python list where PUSH appends to the back, POP removes from the front, and WEIGHT sums all elements.
